text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through this race, it seems Tamamo Cross 
has firmly grasped the tactical nuances of 
long-distance racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Later on, Oguri Cap went on to win a 
graded turf race at 2,000 meters as well, 
expanding her boundless potential even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the whirlwind that is Oguri 
Cap, Tamamo Cross sets her sights on her 
next goal: the Tenno Sho (Spring).
